resources.string:
You have a 30-day free trial with all premium features: 

• Unlimited recording 
• Automatic cloud backup 

After the trial ends, recording duration will be limited to 15 minutes and cloud save will be disabled. 

You can subscribe to a monthly (1.99 USD) or yearly (14.99 USD) plan anytime to keep full access.
Free version: only the last 15 minutes can be saved
